title: Physics undergraduate & front-end developer
body: FIELD JOURNAL Al-Faris Mujahid Hamood AlZakwani I study at Sultan Qaboos University in Oman and founded NexCore Labs, a bilingual student platform. I contributed to the front-end engineering of VitalX, an astronaut health-monitoring proposal. My long-term goal is to apply physics and software to human spaceflight.

title: My Portfolio
body: I designed and built this portfolio in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, including a reduced-motion experience for its orbital visuals.

title: Solvex
body: I built a 3D simulator for a Sultan Qaboos University student team exploring smart agricultural tiles. Adjust solar intensity to see how the model changes the temperature difference and estimated power. The model assumes an ambient range of 28–42 °C and estimates power using a simplified curve proportional to the square of the temperature difference. Physical tile performance would require testing. I later resigned to focus on other fields.

title: NexCore Labs
body: I founded NexCore Labs, an independent student platform in Arabic and English. Students can discover projects through the Project Hub and share ideas through the Contributor Center. For v3.3.0, I fixed the release timeline so readers could see complete release details in both languages and added browser regression coverage.

title: VitalX
body: I contributed front-end development to Team Novacare’s proposed astronaut health-monitoring tool at the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge in Bidiyah. I received the Galactic Problem Solver participation certificate.

title: AlDuwiki Cement Products
body: I developed a company website where customers can browse cement products and approvals, find the company’s location and contact the team.

title: Scorleaf
body: I built the Arabic-language website for Scorleaf, an Omani student health startup. The site introduces the team, its product concept and how to get in touch.

title: MindSync مايندسينك

title: Low Earth orbit debris
body: I am studying orbital mechanics and debris mitigation, with an initial focus on how objects in low Earth orbit lose altitude. Over time, I want to build tools for space research and contribute to human spaceflight.
